name: sellerclaw
description: Operate your SellerClaw e-commerce and marketing channels from Claude — eBay, Shopify, Amazon, Meta Ads, Google Ads and more.
long_description: SellerClaw connects your e-commerce and marketing channels — eBay, Shopify, Amazon, Meta Ads, Google Ads and more — and this extension lets you operate them from Claude. Nothing to install first: the extension talks to SellerClaw's hosted MCP server, so there is no Python, no uv and no CLI to set up. Ask Claude to sign in (the `sellerclaw_login` tool opens your browser to approve access — no API key to copy), then browse command groups, read a command's schema, and run it through three discovery tools. Some actions (e.g. sending email or launching ad campaigns) still require the owner's approval, enforced server-side.

tools.name: sellerclaw_guide
tools.description: Read a task guide with ready-to-run examples: listings, orders, ads, research, analytics.

tools.name: sellerclaw_groups
tools.description: List SellerClaw command groups and the commands inside each.

tools.name: sellerclaw_describe
tools.description: Show one command's full schema: arguments, filters and body fields.

tools.name: sellerclaw_run
tools.description: Run a SellerClaw command and return the API response.

tools.name: sellerclaw_login
tools.description: Sign in to SellerClaw by approving access in the browser.

token.title: SellerClaw token (optional)
token.description: Leave this empty — ask Claude to sign you in and approve access in the browser. Fill it in only for headless setups: an agent token (starts with `sca_`), or one you already have from `sellerclaw auth login`.
